scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -k -n watch,serve -c blue,green "bunx chokidar-cli 'src/**/*' 'df12_pages/**/*' 'config/**/*' 'scripts/**/*' 'pyproject.toml' --initial -i '**/*.pyc' -i '**/__pycache__/**' -i 'src/static/episodic/assets/search/**' -c 'bun run build'" "bunx http-server public -p ${DF12_PORT:-8080} -c-1"
scripts.build: bun run build:static && bun run build:css && bun run build:images && bun run build:pages && bun run build:search && bun run build:static
scripts.build:search: bun run scripts/build-netsuke-search-index.mjs && bun run scripts/build-episodic-search-index.mjs
scripts.build:css: bunx tailwindcss -i ./src/styles/site.css -o ./public/assets/site.css --minify && bun run build:css:mxd && bun run build:css:episodic && bun run build:css:weaver
scripts.serve: bun run build && bunx http-server public -p ${DF12_PORT:-8080}
